name: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan - Kartu Peserta
llm_field_rules: CARD LAYOUT (top to bottom): title 'KARTU PESERTA' → nomor_peserta (numbers) → nomor_kpj (numbers) → name (person name) → registration_date (MM YYYY) → BPJS logo.
nomor_peserta: NUMBERS ONLY. A 16-digit number, may appear with spaces as groups of 4 (e.g. '3306 0445 0195 0002'). Strip spaces. NEVER a person name. Set null if no numeric value found.
nomor_kpj: NUMBERS ONLY. An 11-digit number (e.g. '13032513510'). It appears BELOW nomor_peserta and ABOVE the person name. NEVER a person name or date. Set null if no 11-digit number found.
name: The person's full name in ALL CAPS (e.g. 'ARNEZA ALFAS'). It is alphabetic, NOT a number.
registration_date: Month and year only (e.g. '11 2014' or '10 2013'). A 2-digit month space 4-digit year.
Use null for any field not found. Do NOT guess — if a field value is a name where a number is expected, set it to null.
